text: Every piece of this new platform has been building toward one moment: real Haverbrook Tickets customers running on it instead of the old system.
Celeste Marchbanks reviews the final readiness checklist -- infrastructure, pipeline, monitoring, and support -- and gives the go/no-go call.
Marcus Oyelaran moves real traffic over in three watched stages, ten percent, then fifty, then a hundred, with a tested rollback ready the whole time.
Every stage comes back clean -- latency and error rate stay normal throughout, and the legacy platform stays warm for two more days just in case.
Next: weeks later, checkout starts quietly failing, and every dashboard the team is watching says everything is fine.
